# 失败用例分析报告生成器 (Failure Case Analysis Report Generator)
import json
import os
import sys

def generate_report(data, local_source, ci_source):
    """Generate failure case analysis report."""
    report = ""
    report += "## 失败用例\n"
    for case in data["failed_cases"]:
        report += f"- {case['name']}: {case['reason']}\n"

    report += "## 推荐用例\n"
    matched, total = 0, 0
    for case in data["recommended_cases"]:
        if case["matched"]:
            matched += 1
        total += 1
        report += f"- {case['name']}\n"

    if total == 0:
        report += "无推荐用例\n"

    report += "- [来源: 本地文件] %s\n" % local_source
    report += "- [来源: 历史CI] %s\n" % ci_source
    report += "命中推荐: %d / %d\n" % (matched, total)
    return report
